limits: For red wine, Grenache: at least 40%
For red wine, the complementary grapes together: at least 20%
For white wine, the main grapes together: at least 70%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A Rhône Valley appellation in the southern Rhône, in the Vaucluse, for red and white wine, mainly from Grenache, Clairette, Grenache Blanc and Roussanne. It was part of Côtes-du-Rhône Villages until it won its own appellation, confirmed in 2018.
